title: A Clam Named Ming Lived 507 Years, the Oldest Animal Ever

scenes.text: A clam lived 507 years, until scientists pulled it up.
It was dredged off the coast of Iceland in 2006.
Scientists named it Ming, after the Chinese dynasty ruling when it was born.
Its shell has yearly growth rings, like a tree. Counting them gave 507 years.
That makes it the oldest animal with a known age.

description:
A clam lived 507 years, until scientists pulled it up.
Ming was an ocean quahog dredged off Iceland in 2006. Counting the yearly rings in its shell showed it was about 507 years old, born around 1499, the longest life ever confirmed for an individual animal.
What would you have done in 1499? Comment below.
first_comment: At its birth, nobody in Europe knew about the Americas yet. What year would you pick to live through?
